about: Streams refused whole (ADR-0064, ADR-0065): a schema whose names or metadata a Snapshot cannot take, a Record Key Blank or carried twice, and bytes that are not a whole Arrow stream or file. Transcribed from ExGrid.Data.Arrow.Tests' RefusalTests and ProducerTests.

cases.name: ADR-0064: two columns of one name are refused, naming it, as a Snapshot's names are unique

refused.message: Column 'A': the Arrow stream has two columns of this name, and a column's name is unique within a Snapshot.

cases.name: ADR-0064: a column without a name is refused, as every column of a Snapshot is named

refused.message: The Arrow stream's column 2 has no name; every column of a Snapshot is named.

cases.name: ADR-0065: a version in the metadata that is not a whole number, 0 or more, 'abc', is refused

refused.message: The Arrow stream's exgrid.version metadata 'abc' is not a version: a version is a whole number, 0 or more.

cases.name: ADR-0065: a version in the metadata that is not a whole number, 0 or more, '-1', is refused

refused.message: The Arrow stream's exgrid.version metadata '-1' is not a version: a version is a whole number, 0 or more.

cases.name: ADR-0065: a version in the metadata that is not a whole number, 0 or more, '1.5', is refused

refused.message: The Arrow stream's exgrid.version metadata '1.5' is not a version: a version is a whole number, 0 or more.

cases.name: ADR-0065: a Record Key the metadata names and the stream does not hold is refused, naming it

refused.message: The Arrow stream names 'Id' its Record Key (exgrid.recordKey), and holds no column of that name.

cases.name: ADR-0064: a Record Key that is neither Text nor Integer is refused, naming its column

refused.message: Column 'Price': the Arrow stream names it the Record Key, and a Record Key is a Text or an Integer column; this one is Double.

cases.name: ADR-0064: a Blank Record Key is refused, naming its row and the key's column

refused.message: Row 2, column 'Id': the Record Key is Blank.

cases.name: ADR-0064: a Text Record Key carried twice is refused, naming the key

refused.message: Row 4, column 'Id': the Record Key 'T1' is already carried by row 1.

cases.name: ADR-0064: an Integer Record Key carried twice is refused, naming the key

refused.message: Row 3, column 'Id': the Record Key 5 is already carried by row 1.

cases.name: ADR-0064: rows with no column are refused, as a Snapshot holds rows only in its columns and would read them as none

refused.message: The Arrow stream holds 3 rows and no column, and a Snapshot holds rows only in its columns.

cases.name: ADR-0065: bytes that are not Arrow, a CSV, are refused as not Arrow

refused.message: The bytes are not an Arrow IPC stream or file: they begin with neither an IPC message nor ARROW1.

cases.name: ADR-0065: bytes that are not Arrow, JSON, are refused as not Arrow

refused.message: The bytes are not an Arrow IPC stream or file: they begin with neither an IPC message nor ARROW1.

cases.name: ADR-0065: bytes that are not Arrow, an error page, are refused as not Arrow

refused.message: The bytes are not an Arrow IPC stream or file: they begin with neither an IPC message nor ARROW1.

cases.name: ADR-0065: bytes that are not Arrow, Parquet, are refused as not Arrow

refused.message: The bytes are not an Arrow IPC stream or file: they begin with neither an IPC message nor ARROW1.

cases.name: ADR-0065: bytes that are not Arrow, zeros, are refused as not Arrow

refused.message: The bytes are not an Arrow IPC stream or file: they begin with neither an IPC message nor ARROW1.

cases.name: ADR-0065: a stream that begins with a record batch rather than its schema is refused as not Arrow

refused.message: The bytes are not an Arrow IPC stream or file: they begin with neither an IPC message nor ARROW1.

cases.name: ADR-0065: an Arrow stream compressed with gzip, as an HTTP response is before it is undone, is refused, saying so

refused.saying: The bytes are compressed with gzip, not an Arrow IPC stream or file: undo the compression first.

cases.name: ADR-0065: no bytes at all are an empty stream, refused

refused.message: The Arrow stream is empty: it holds no schema.

cases.name: ADR-0065: an end-of-stream marker alone is an empty stream, refused

refused.message: The Arrow stream is empty: it holds no schema.

cases.name: ADR-0065: bytes that end inside their first message are refused as not Arrow or cut short

refused.message: The bytes end inside their first message: they are not an Arrow IPC stream, or they are one cut short; a stream is read only whole.

cases.name: ADR-0064: a stream cut short before the end-of-stream marker is refused, never read as fewer rows

refused.message: The Arrow stream ends before its end-of-stream marker, so it may have been cut short; a stream is read only whole.

cases.name: ADR-0064: a stream cut short inside the end-of-stream marker is refused, never read as fewer rows

refused.message: The Arrow stream ends before its end-of-stream marker, so it may have been cut short; a stream is read only whole.

cases.name: ADR-0064: a stream cut short inside a record batch's body is refused, never read as fewer rows

refused.message: The Arrow stream ends before its end-of-stream marker, so it may have been cut short; a stream is read only whole.

cases.name: ADR-0064: a stream cut short inside a record batch's metadata is refused, never read as fewer rows

refused.message: The Arrow stream ends before its end-of-stream marker, so it may have been cut short; a stream is read only whole.

cases.name: ADR-0064: a stream cut short between two record batches is refused, never read as fewer rows

refused.message: The Arrow stream ends before its end-of-stream marker, so it may have been cut short; a stream is read only whole.

cases.name: ADR-0064: an Arrow file cut short, its footer gone, is refused

refused.message: The Arrow file ends without its footer, so it may have been cut short; a file is read only whole.

cases.name: ADR-0064: an Arrow file cut short, to its first eight bytes, is refused

refused.message: The Arrow file ends without its footer, so it may have been cut short; a file is read only whole.
